d: Newly published excerpts from Pope Francis' personal diaries have revealed an unusual claim: the late pontiff said he had three physical encounters with the Devil and even experienced a vision of the gates of hell. The revelation has sent social media into a frenzy, with users turning the mysterious encounters into a political guessing game. Donald Trump, JD Vance, Benjamin Netanyahu and Marco Rubio have all featured in viral posts suggesting they could be the Devil Pope Francis encountered.
